name: SortableBoard
description: A drag-and-drop Kanban-style board component built on @dnd-kit. Renders columns with draggable items that can be reordered within a column or moved between columns. Supports custom item rendering via a renderItem prop. Columns auto-fit to fill available width using CSS grid.

props.name: defaultColumns
props.description: The initial column definitions. Each column has a title, items array of string IDs, and an optional id (auto-generated as 'col-{index}' if omitted).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback invoked when items are reordered or moved between columns. Receives the full updated columns array.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Custom render function for each draggable item. Receives the item's string ID. When omitted, items display their ID as plain text.

types.name: DefaultColumnType
types.definition: { id?: string; title: string; items: string[] }
types.description: Column definition for initial setup. id is optional and auto-generated if not provided.

types.name: ColumnType
types.definition: { id: string; title: string; items: string[] }
types.description: Column definition as returned by onChange. id is always present.

accessibility.keyboard: Provided by @dnd-kit: Space/Enter to pick up and drop items. Arrow keys to move items. Escape to cancel drag.
accessibility.aria: Managed by @dnd-kit: aria-grabbed, aria-dropeffect, live region announcements for drag start, over, and end events.
accessibility.notes: Each item has a dedicated drag handle (GripVertical icon) with touch-action: none for mobile compatibility. Items display a grip icon on the right side as a visual drag affordance. Empty columns show a placeholder message.

examples.title: Basic SortableBoard
examples.code:
<SortableBoard
  defaultColumns={[
    { title: "To Do", items: ["task-1", "task-2", "task-3"] },
    { title: "In Progress", items: ["task-4"] },
    { title: "Done", items: ["task-5", "task-6"] }
  ]}
  onChange={(columns) => console.log(columns)}
/>

examples.title: SortableBoard with Custom Item Rendering
examples.code:
(
{id} Task description
)} onChange={(columns) => console.log(columns)} />
